comments.text: I love this music video. This "Goddess of Music" sees a sad guy and gives him a guitar; she cheers him up, and he goes on to bring joy to others—poor, sick, and invisible people—through his music. Later, he realizes he can make money, so he starts playing for pay—but only around rich people—and loses the love he once had for what he did. Because of this, she punishes him, and the guitar falls to the ground, showing that it wasn't the instrument that created the music, but the person playing it.
